question: What does my basket-mix look like compared to peers? Where am I over or under indexed?

tool_calls.query:
SELECT p.category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.txn_id) AS txn_count,
       SUM(i.qty) AS units,
       SUM(i.qty * i.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON p.sku = i.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'KRG'
  AND DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-29'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT *
FROM lake_transactions
WHERE peer_segment = 'grocery'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT category,
       SUM(qty) AS units,
       SUM(line_total) AS revenue
FROM lake_transactions
WHERE peer_segment = 'grocery'
  AND DATE(txn_date) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-29'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
